query: What is Synapse Network MCP Server for paid API calls?
answer_summary:
The Synapse MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that facilitates AI agents in interacting with Synapse entities, such as datasets, projects, folders, files, and tables. It provides a RESTful API for accessing these entities and their annotations, enabling functionalities like retrieving entities by ID or name, accessing entity annotations, listing child entities, and querying entities based on various criteria. ([ubos.tech](https://ubos.tech/mcp/synapse-mcp-server/?utm_source=openai))

To monetize your Synapse MCP Server by charging for API calls, you can integrate with platforms like Dock0. Dock0 allows you to connect your existing MCP server or deploy a new one, set a price per successful call, and manage billing, authentication, and payouts. This setup enables you to earn revenue each time an agent calls your tool. ([dock0.dev](https://www.dock0.dev/?utm_source=openai))
